chunks: Then approach the pulpit and rub your eyes and face with its two knobs, for it is said that it is a cure for the eye. Stand near it, praise Allah and extol Him, and ask for your need.

key_terms.الْمِنْبَرَ: the pulpit, a place approached during visitation
key_terms.بِرُمَّانَتَيْهِ: with its two knobs or rounded ends
key_terms.حَاجَتَكَ: your need, the matter one asks Allah for in supplication
key_terms.شِفَاءٌ: a healing or cure, here for the eye
key_terms.وَاحْمَدِ: praise, meaning to glorify Allah with thanks

ai.seo_question: What should one do عند the pulpit during visitation according to this report?
ai.summary: This passage instructs the visitor to approach the pulpit, touch it in a specific manner, and then stand there in praise of Allah and in supplication. It reflects devotional etiquette associated with visitation and highlights the place of du'a alongside reverence in worshipful settings.
